node.statement: By def-signed-idempotent, P^2=P gives row reproduction p_v=sum_j alpha_j p_j=sum_j alpha_j^+ p_j - sum_k alpha_k^- p_k. By lem-mass-split, sum_j alpha_j^+=1+nu_v=sum_j alpha_k^-+1, so sum_{j notin A} alpha_j^+ - sum_k alpha_k^- = 1-sigma_a; since this case assumes sigma_a<1, substituting the displayed q gives the asserted split.
